name: Conformance: Bounded loopback (refine, withdraw)
description: RFC 0258. draft (core.identity, echoes its inputs) → gate (core.approvalGate, accept/reject/refine) → apply (core.noop), plus a loopback edge gate → draft {on: refine, maxIterations: 2, historyInput: rounds}. Each refine re-runs draft and asks gate again; draft echoes the round history it received. After two refines the third visit omits refine (onExhausted defaults to withdraw), and accept runs apply once. Conformance scenario: v2-bounded-loopback.test.ts.
